endpoints.label: All InterPro entries
endpoints.describes: List InterPro entries; filter by type (family, domain, homologous_superfamily, repeat, site).

endpoints.label: InterPro entry by accession (e.g. IPR011615)
endpoints.describes: Fetch a single InterPro entry by its IPR accession.

endpoints.label: InterPro entries for a UniProt accession
endpoints.describes: All InterPro domains, families, and sites mapped onto a given UniProt protein.

endpoints.label: Proteins matching an InterPro entry
endpoints.describes: All UniProt proteins that match a given InterPro entry; filter by tax_id for species-restricted lookup.

endpoints.label: PDB structures linked to an InterPro entry
endpoints.describes: PDB structures associated with an InterPro entry — useful for cross-referencing inversion-disrupted domains to known protein structures.

endpoints.label: Taxonomic distribution of an InterPro entry
endpoints.describes: Species in which a particular InterPro entry occurs — for the cross_species_atlas, lets us check whether a domain is conserved across catfish.
